nature_system_demo.name: Nature System Demo
nature_system_demo.description: Visual test scene for the Q-FEP Nature System. Spawns critters from all 4 kingdoms (tree, creature, flower, fungus) in a grid. Keyboard controls: 1-4 spawn by kingdom, R randomize DNA, E evolve, L cycle LOD, H toggle hybrids, SPACE reset grid.
nature_system_demo.qfep_connection: Transmutation as free energy minimization — every critter is an algorithm exploring possibility space under constraints. Bonding with a critter changes the relationship, not the critter. The poison was always medicine. Donna Haraway meets Q-FEP.
